question: What mature public baseline capability and physical call accounting must a future PN comparison preserve?

existing_anywin.default: stop_after_root_win=False; actual completed root child may already survive a later aborted iteration.
existing_anywin.optional: True exits after a qualifying improving mate-band root child or a compatible completed/warm winning return, with actual result source and last uniform completed depth preserved.
existing_anywin.not_new_PN: Saving a completed winning child is already baseline infrastructure. It is not a novel PN mechanism or proof of a completed deeper whole iteration.
existing_anywin.not_Session_certificate: PlayerDecision provides action/score/PV/provenance, not an independently checked all-defense SessionWinCertificate. Do not convert result_source or mate score alone into that transport.
existing_anywin.prior_source_tests: Read only: h3 all-defense controls, window equality refusal, Core/Native variants, warm TT, controls after callback and static-score clamp. They were NOT re-executed; no new Player call.
existing_anywin.actual_learner: Maintained q0 adapter rejects nonliteral completed_root_win as a TDLeaf target; this is an existing correct distinction.

baseline_relevance: Any future PN mechanism should state what it adds beyond this existing anytime behavior, its full-history TT, q policy, root tactical handling and actual current move ordering.

The old proof chooser simple fallback is not this baseline. Source search over scripts/generic_chess found no current direct solver+public AlphaBetaPlayer full-PlayerDecision chooser; this is scoped source coverage, not proof no future consumer can exist.

Proof rank is a checked worst-case strategy-depth bound, peak_depth is deepest inspected PN node, completed_depth is uniform alpha-beta completion; those units cannot be advertised as a depth speedup ratio.
Choosing any WIN is not necessarily shortest mate. A winning root action need not show a strength gain over another winning baseline action.

future_budget_arithmetic.Pro_proposal: At most32physical1second search-service queries arranged in pairs; construction/verification/whole comparison also need explicit bounded accounting.
future_budget_arithmetic.meaning: Clarification of a proposed future count, NOT a launched/frozen AUX schedule or implementation authorization.
future_budget_arithmetic.failures: Every attempted slot retains its outcome; a started failure still consumes its one physical invocation. Do not silently refill a missing return or reinterpret32pairs as32calls.
future_budget_arithmetic.time: Per-call nominal caps do not mathematically guarantee total actual32seconds when atomic operations overrun; actual cumulative service and a separate declared whole envelope must be reported.
